name: Tham Luang, Drawn
th: ถ้ำหลวง วาดด้วยคณิต
note: The 2018 Tham Luang cave rescue drawn with math: eighteen days under the Sleeping Lady, the way in, the 38 × 72 cm squeeze, a billion litres of water, the thinning air, the way out, the ten thousand people, and those remembered, Erik Brown among them
